title: Some New Samsung Device Owners Are Running Into RCS Messaging Issues - CNET
summary: Some users of Google Messages are having trouble accessing RCS messaging on newer smartphones from Samsung. Later in 2024, Samsung formally partnered with Google to ensure RCS worked well on Samsung devices running Android.
